controls.intent: Disable only matchDeclarationsOrder: the reordered but valid subjects stop reporting while the removed parameter remains a finding. This is a selective real configuration control, not a blank pass.
Incorrect prose has no @param/@property subject list, so this rule deliberately abstains. Empty output is not proof that the API documentation is true.

limitations: Opt-in documentation/signature convention, not general API semantics or documentation truth. No relevant parsed tags means no finding.
This batch covers function type/value parameters, order and invalid subjects, not all class/constructor visibility, property tags, fenced-code/lexer recovery or exhaustive option combinations.
Disabling order matching must not hide invalid parameter names; the configuration contrast explicitly retains the unrelated finding.
No Kotlin compilation, API binary compatibility, documentation completeness or parser-compatibility qualification.

six_case_plan.positive: Run the exact owner-selected syntax route on these immutable source bytes. Expected ranges are authored from the pinned predicate, never observed output.
six_case_plan.negative: Run the independent valid alternative with this SAME rule active and require an enabled upstream descriptor even with no finding.
six_case_plan.configuration: Replay original positive bytes with the selected rule explicitly disabled. This is a separately counted configuration control, never a scope/default-activation reduction.
six_case_plan.version: Replay positive bytes under the pinned CLI; require a fresh per-cohort version probe and two per-rule Common/Native abstentions. Modeled baseline 2.4.21 versus parser 2.4.10 remains unqualified.
six_case_plan.suppression: Use genuine upstream file annotation only on an additional package-isolated copy; the unsuppressed original neighbor must keep every expected range.
six_case_plan.regression: Seal the negative correction as the child of suppression, delete the obsolete suppressed copy, and verify both registered parent and child unchanged.

qualification_note: Authored ranges/intents are not observed diagnostics. Retain unexpected/false-positive outputs and all misses; never rewrite expectations to force a pass. Real isolated runner, active descriptor, source snapshots and fresh source-bound evidence require separate root admission. No natural-project, performance, parser, semantic, model or release qualification.
